title: Geometric base change of the tensor counit transpose
statement: Fix P, separated finite-type k0-models X0,Y0 and a separated finite-type morphism f0, and put f,gX,gY,Q,R as in [def-pur-finite-geometric-purity-coordinates]. Let M be bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude on Y, and choose any etale presentations c0:C(M0)~N(M) and c1:C(M1)~N(RM). Let t_(M,c0), t_(RM,c1), S_M and e_omega be the explicit tensor factors and unit exchange of [lem-pur-finite-geometric-purity-factorization], and e_M the unique compact-support counit mate. Then Q(t_(M,c0));e_M=S_M;(1 tensor e_omega);t_(RM,c1). No relative dimension, diagonal orientation, shift or primitive root appears in this statement.

source.place: Geometric base change of the tensor counit transpose

proof.text: Use the etale presentations and the canonical realization units in the definition of the two theta maps. Retagging changes neither the compact-support functor nor its proper/open exchange and refinement. The compact projection base-change identity identifies the inverse projection transformations in these presentations.

Apply the tensor-counit exchange calculus to the actual compact-support exchange. Its unit counit equation gives ordinary exceptional base change at A_Y followed by the ordinary unit comparison; under canonical comparison this is e_omega. At M the counit equation and uniqueness identify the exchange with e_M. The two composites have the same inverse-projection/unit-counit transpose, so injectivity of the bounded etale-origin Hom bijection gives equality.

source.place: Clause (2), tensor transpose and counit mate

proof.text: Tensor pullback, the square compositor and the two realization units are precisely S_M. The exceptional images of the inverse realization units finish t_(M,c0) and t_(RM,c1), giving the displayed equality. Origin and bounded-below preservation justify all transpose domains.

proof_origin.place: The two factors (1)--(2), in the fixed-scalar Frobenius coordinates of the parent node
